entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup` should convert installs based on the `path` winning dotnet, not system `dotnet` #55417
  • zsh autocompletions script emits invalid option switches #55416
  • Test flakiness for Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToBuildAnAppWithLibrary.It_generates_satellite_assemblies #55408
  • Add affected-test selection to `dotnet test` #55405
  • CA1516 emits an empty diagnostic message (no message text), producing a SARIF result with no message #55403

Closed

  • `dotnetUp` could be resilient to changes in Unix admin paths #51601
  • dotnet test opaquely fails with Zero tests ran in MTP mode when --nologo is used #55309
  • `dotnet test` support for traversal projects in .NET 10 #51316

PullRequests

Created

  • Migrate to custom OTel Exporter in `dotnetup` to prevent perf delay and data loss #55421
  • Simplify MacAddressGetter to use NetworkInterface API directly #55420
  • Add MTP artifact post-processing to dotnet test #55419
  • Enable live output for MSTest tests #55418
  • Add OCI container annotation support #55415
    Area-Containers
  • Fix multi-arch container label parsing #55414
    Area-Containers, 11.0.1xx
  • [main] Fix Native AOT SDK version lookup #55413
    backport
  • Add deep-nested traversal e2e tests for dotnet test (MTP) #55407
  • [dotnet-watch tests] Cap output-wait timeout below the MTP hang-dump #55406
  • Enable fully qualified Helix test name reporting #55404
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55402

Merged

  • dotnetup: classify PATH dotnet by managed hive; fix env config doc #55349
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Support --nologo in Microsoft.Testing.Platform test mode #55409
    Approved to merge, backport
  • Re-enable C++/CLI test coverage previously gated on VS 2026 toolset availability #54558
  • Expose --no-banner in MTP dotnet test help #55412
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Support Microsoft.Build.Traversal projects in dotnet test (MTP) #55411
    Servicing-consider
  • Fix Native AOT SDK version lookup #55410
    Servicing-consider
  • Support Microsoft.Build.Traversal projects in dotnet test (MTP) #55297
  • Support --nologo in Microsoft.Testing.Platform test mode #55376
  • Escape semicolons in conditional test scope pipeline variable #55401

Updated

  • Host the Razor source generator in rzc (opt-in generate/discover) #55422
  • Add --allow-prerelease and --no-sdk-version options to dotnet new globaljson template #54133
  • Bump minimum MSBuild version to 18.7 #55230
  • Add `dotnetup` Version Intent & Timeline Doc #55390
  • Normalize SDK build leg naming #55400
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to MSTest/Helix #55399
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #55267
    Branch Lockdown
  • Move VirtualProjectBuilder to FileBasedPrograms source package #54773
    Area-run-file
  • Fixed a lot of typos in the codebase and documentation #55327
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Add test authoring guidance for Helix compatibility and TFM properties #55388
  • Preserve whitespace paths in static web asset tasks #55266
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #55318
    Branch Lockdown
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #55333
    Branch Lockdown
